```lean
import CategoryTheory
import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.LocallySmall
import CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C]
  [CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.{w, v, u} C] :
  CategoryTheory.HasSubobjectClassifier (CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) := by
  let F := Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)
  let E := F.Elements

  have h_locally_small : LocallySmall.{w, v, u} F :=
    by apply CategoryTheory.locallySmall_of_essentiallySmall
       exact CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.of_unop
       exact CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.of_functor _ _ _
       exact CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.of_unop
       exact CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.of_functor _ _ _

  have h_cartesian_closed : CartesianClosed F :=
    by apply Functor.CartesianClosed.of_small_domain
       exact CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.of_unop
       exact CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.of_functor _ _ _

  have h_subobject_classifier : HasSubobjectClassifier F :=
    by apply CategoryTheory.CartesianClosed.hasSubobjectClassifier
       exact h_cartesian_closed
       exact h_locally_small

  exact h_subobject_classifier
```
